text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wow! They're all so cute! And there's so
many of
them! You're incredible!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Trainer, you really did your best
for me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy I could fly to the moon!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll pretend each and every one of them
is you and
hug them really tight every
day!
